description:

A deadly home invasion claims the life of Washington Redskins safety Sean Taylor, leading many to wonder if it was an obsessed fan, a targeted hit, or an inside job; after media speculation runs wild, an anonymous tip reveals the truth.

description:

In Hayti, Mo., Tray Phelps is found beaten to death in his driveway; the townspeople are stunned to discover that a web of evil lurks just beneath the surface of the seemingly idyllic hamlet.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:

The building of a backyard shed destroys a years-long, close relationship between two neighbors and ignites a vicious conflict that sees property destroyed, pets killed, and finally two people shot to death in cold blood.

title: Murder Among Friends
description:

After a young man is found slain in a cemetery, there are whispers his death was part of a ritual sacrifice, but detectives aren't prepared for the black magic, satanic rituals and psychic visions at the heart of this truly twisted murder.

title: Murder Among Friends
description:

In Northern California, an anonymous tip leads detectives to a decaying corpse, buried at a mountain campsite; as police investigate their victim's past, they unveil a boisterous life of love, jealousy and one truly shocking secret.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E04 — A Shot in the Night
A 33-year-old single mother, Lindsey Wilkins is found shot in the head by an apparent suicide, but when no gun is found, police suspect murder and uncover a trail of secrets and betrayals with a shocking twist puts the case in jeopardy.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E05 — Online Secrets
In 2014, the scorched remains of a house fire reveal two female victims, Robin Aldridge, 58, and her daughter, Mani, 17; when investigators dig deeper into the women's lives, they uncover a secret online relationship that led to tragedy.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E01 — Murder in the Park
Nineteen-year-old single mother Cheyenne Clough is brutally assaulted and left in a secluded park to die; as police investigate, they discover a trail of blind loyalty and deadly betrayal that may have led to her murder.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E01 — No End In Sight
Debbie Puglisi is enjoying life with her husband in their new dream home, but when an unexpected visitor drops by the neighborhood, Debbie's whole world becomes a nightmare.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E03 — The Watcher
Single mom Carrie Caudill and a friend embark on a girls' night out, but an unexpected confrontation puts Carrie on a dangerous collision course with a sadistic madman.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E07 — The Night Shift
Single mother Barbara Nunn relocates to Florida, but she struggles to find her way; after she lands a job at a local diner, it appears her troubles are finally behind her; one night, a surprise confrontation with customers ends in murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E07 — She Isn't Acting Dead Enough
A man crashes into the back of a woman's vehicle; officers respond to the scene only to find her car abandoned; witnesses point to the other driver, and detectives are horrified to discover a sadistic psychopath who admits to murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E06 — I Was a Star
A woman dies in a brutal stabbing at home; police quickly locate the prime suspect, her ex-boyfriend Antoine Bynum; in his interrogation, he appears to have a psychotic episode until detectives discover it's merely the ruse of a deranged psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E03 — God Was Going to Use Me
A longtime nurse confesses to helping end the lives of numerous elderly patients at multiple nursing homes; detectives discover this is no angel of mercy; behind her unsuspecting persona lies a ruthless psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E01 — Everyone Has a Death Sentence
The Tourniquet Killer terrorizes young girls across Houston, Texas, and when advances in DNA finally lead to his arrest, this psychopath eagerly confesses to multiple murders; weeks before his execution, he grants one interview in the spotlight.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:

Elisabeth and Frank reconnect after years apart, and Elisabeth's mother, Cheri, watches as their toxic relationship blows up and leads to a devastating fire; when the smoke clears, one lies dead, and the other sits behind bars.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:
S01 E04 — The Kansas City Strangler
During the day, Lorenzo Gilyard is a soft-spoken and well-liked man, but at night, he's a monster, preying on women; his best friend, a trained social worker, misses the signs; going inside the prison to get answers from the notorious serial killer.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:
S01 E06 — I Always Knew I Could Kill
Patrick Piddock knows there's something dark inside him, and his daughter, Fawn, and those around him suffer from his sudden outbursts; he's warned that one day he'll kill someone, but no one knows how dangerous he is until he takes a life.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:
S01 E01 — Body in the Barrel
Michelle looks up to her father, but over time, fear and disgust replaces respect; as a teen, her world changes forever as horrific revelations buried for years finally emerge; Michelle's father must answer for his crimes.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:

A chilling look inside the homes of actual killers; a peek at their prisons to hear from killers themselves, resulting in powerful, unsettling and contentious encounters.

The Laffertys are pillars of the Mormon community, and they are known as an example of wholesome family values, as seen in home videos; however, an evil is lurking that will one day explode into an unholy double homicide.
